# Vendored

- `marked.esm.js`: [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) 16.1.1, `lib/marked.esm.js`, MIT (`marked.LICENSE.md`). Unchanged except the trailing `sourceMappingURL` comment, removed because the map isn't shipped. Used by `doc.js` to render plan, phase and item docs. To update, copy the new release's `lib/marked.esm.js` and `LICENSE.md` over these and remove that comment again.
